design.referenceConsumer: examples/external-consumer/reference-consumer.mjs — one ESM file, node builtins only (node:child_process, node:path, node:url), no non-builtin specifier, no repository path, no relative parent path, no require. It takes a materialized payload directory and the expected distribution version
design.orderOfOperations: the payload's own diagnose.mjs is spawned FIRST as a separate process rooted at the payload directory, so the payload passes its own ten P24A gates before THIS reference consumer trusts it. Only on a healthy report does this consumer import the generated module, via a file URL resolved from the modulePath the runner itself reported, and only then is one sample report printed. The ordering is scoped to this consumer and to its own process. It is NOT a claim that the module has never been imported or evaluated anywhere: the shipped P24A runner carries its own module_evaluation gate, which imports a copy of the generated module source as a data: URL inside its own process, on verified bytes, before it reports healthy. On the healthy path the source has therefore already been evaluated once, elsewhere, by the time this consumer imports anything; on a refusing path whether it was evaluated depends on which of the runner's ten gates refused, since the earlier integrity gates fire before module_evaluation. Either way, no wording in this package claims a first-ever import, and none claims a refused payload was never evaluated — only that this consumer never imported it

codeMap.MISSING_ARGUMENT: no payload directory, or no expected distribution version, was supplied. Decided before THIS consumer imports the generated module
codeMap.DIAGNOSTICS_FAILED: the shipped diagnose.mjs could not be run, refused, printed no JSON report, or reported anything other than a healthy payload with a generated module path. Decided before THIS consumer imports the generated module. The shipped runner may already have evaluated a copy of the module source at its own module_evaluation gate, so this is a not-imported-here property, not a never-evaluated one
codeMap.MODULE_UNUSABLE: a runner-accepted module still failed to import into THIS consumer, or imported and did not expose its declared action surface. It occurs only after this consumer's import attempt has begun, and never before it. Two distinct states sit under this one code and are not flattened into each other: if the import itself throws, the module may not have loaded at all; otherwise the module did load and export validation ran after that load. It is never claimed that the module is always loaded when this code fires. No case in the frozen test reaches it, because every failure that test exercises is caught by the shipped runner first; it exists so the example refuses instead of crashing with a stack trace

design.failClosed: every refusal exits 1, writes nothing to stdout, and emits exactly one EXTERNAL_CONSUMER_ERROR:<CODE> line at the start of a stderr line. The refusals do NOT share one position relative to the import, and the record states the difference instead of generalising it: MISSING_ARGUMENT and DIAGNOSTICS_FAILED are decided strictly before THIS reference consumer imports the generated module, so a payload its own runner rejects is never imported by this consumer — which is deliberately not stated as never evaluated, because the shipped P24A runner has its own module_evaluation gate that imports a copy of that module source in its own process, and whether it reached that gate before refusing is the runner's business, not a property this record may assert; MODULE_UNUSABLE occurs only after this consumer's import attempt has begun and never before it, covering two states that are recorded separately — if the import throws the module may not have loaded at all, and otherwise the module loaded and export validation ran after that load. It is not described as a refusal taken with the module always loaded, because that is not true of the throwing case
design.orderingProof: the frozen test prepends an observable side-effect marker to the generated module in every refusal case it exercises. The marker never appears, which proves the pre-import ordering for exactly the refusals that test drives: MISSING_ARGUMENT and DIAGNOSTICS_FAILED. It proves nothing about MODULE_UNUSABLE, which no test case reaches and which by construction cannot be pre-import
design.reportShape: one deterministic JSON object — schemaVersion, status ok, coordinate, distributionVersion, action, the runner's own diagnostics report embedded byte for byte, and a sample section (request, outcome, outcomeAccepted, errorEnvelope, errorEnvelopeAccepted) derived from the generated module's exports. No host path, no timestamp, no readiness term

claims.supersededClaim: EVERY_REFUSAL_HAPPENS_BEFORE_THE_GENERATED_MODULE_IS_IMPORTED — withdrawn as false. It was true of MISSING_ARGUMENT and DIAGNOSTICS_FAILED and false of MODULE_UNUSABLE, which can only be decided once the import has been attempted. The broad wording generalised a property the frozen test proves for two refusals into a claim about all three
honest: The protocol is written down before the first run, so whoever runs it later cannot loosen it afterwards. That is the whole of what a written protocol delivers.

The reference consumer is genuinely copy-and-run: the frozen test copies the file OUT of this repository into a temporary directory, runs it from an unrelated working directory with an empty environment, and it still works, so the only way it reaches the payload is the argument it was given.

Running the payload's own runner first is a real ordering property for the refusals it governs: MISSING_ARGUMENT and DIAGNOSTICS_FAILED are proved to fire before THIS consumer imports the generated module, so a payload its own gates reject is never imported or evaluated by this reference consumer. It says nothing about evaluation in the shipped runner's own process.

MODULE_UNUSABLE is a genuine exception to that ordering and is recorded as one. It occurs only after the import attempt has begun: a throw from the import itself may leave the module never loaded, while past that point the module loaded and export validation ran on it. What still holds in both states, and is stated separately because it is a separate property: exit 1, empty stdout, exactly one stable EXTERNAL_CONSUMER_ERROR line.
notClaimed: the protocol alone is proof of nothing, and adding it proves nothing about whether anyone outside can use the payload
no external, independent or counted team consumed anything; teamsCountedToDate is 0

not claimed that MODULE_UNUSABLE is exercised by any test; it is unreached by the frozen test and its behaviour rests on construction and inspection, not on a passing case
the reference consumer is an example, not a product, a service or a supported client library
the shipped runner it invokes detects accidental drift only; it is not tamper-proof and not a signature, exactly as P24A recorded

not claimed that this consumer performs the module's first-ever import; the shipped P24A runner evaluates a copy of the module source in its own process before this consumer imports anything, and no wording in this package says otherwise any more

nonblockingRisks.ifItEverBites: the fix is local to fail() and would be a separate package: write synchronously, or set process.exitCode and let the process end naturally

ownerFacing.once: Paketi disaridan alacak bir ekip icin hicbir kural yaziliydi degildi. Kimin 'disaridan bagimsiz ekip' sayilacagi, ekibe tam olarak neyin verilecegi ve bir denemeyi neyin gecersiz kilacagi belli degildi. Calisan ornek de yoktu: paketi bastan sona tuketen tek bir dosya bile bulunmuyordu.
ownerFacing.simdi: Iki sey eklendi. Birincisi, tek bir makine tarafindan okunabilir blok halinde yazili giris protokolu: sadece gercek bagimsiz ekip sayilir; ajan, calisan, otomatik sonda ve isci asla sayilmaz; ekibe tam dort girdi verilir; kabul cizgisi uc bagimsiz ekip ve sifir sahip yardimi, her yardim olayi kayitli; gizlenen sahip yardimi, ekip olmayan katilimci ve sonradan degistirilen kanit denemeyi gecersiz kilar; kabul edilen kanit sha256 ile muhurlenir ve sonradan degistirilemez. Ikincisi, tek dosyalik calisan ornek tuketici: hicbir bagimliligi yok, depomuzdan hicbir sey almiyor, once paketin kendi kontrol dosyasini ayri bir surec olarak calistiriyor, ancak saglikli raporu aldiktan SONRA modulu yukluyor ve tek bir ornek rapor yaziyor.
ownerFacing.fark: Protokol kurallar yazildiktan sonra gevsetilemeyecek sekilde tek bir blokta duruyor. Ornek dosya depodan disari kopyalanip alakasiz bir klasorden, bos bir ortamla calistirildi ve calisti. P07/P08/P09/P24A dosyalarina tek bayt dokunulmadi. Ayrica iki turda iki yanlis cumle duzeltildi: once 'her reddedis modul yuklenmeden once olur' (ucun ikisi icin dogru, ucuncusu icin yanlisti), sonra 'ucuncu red modul zaten yuklenmisken olur' (modul yuklenirken hata firlarsa modul hic yuklenmemis olabilir). Ikisi de artik oldugu gibi yaziyor. Ucuncu turda ise yukleme iddialari bu ornege daraltildi: paketin kendi kontrol dosyasi modulun bir kopyasini kendi surecinde zaten calistirdigi icin artik hicbir yerde 'ilk yukleme' ya da 'hic calistirilmadi' denmiyor. Dorduncu turda ayni daraltma dokumanin kendisine de islendi: 'kendi kontrolunden kalan paket hic calistirilmaz' cumlesi artik 'BU ornek tuketici onu hic yuklemez ve calistirmaz' diyor, arkasindan da bunun sadece bu surece ait bir ozellik oldugu yaziyor.
ownerFacing.durustSinir: Kural yazmak kanit degildir. Bugune kadar disaridan tek bir ekip bile paketi almadi, sayac 0, sahibin ne kadar yardim ettigi hic olculmedi. Reddedislerin sirasi da artik oldugu gibi yaziyor, ama sadece BU ornek icin: eksik argumanda ve paket kendi kontrolunden kalinca BU ORNEK modulu HIC yuklemiyor. Bu, 'modul hicbir yerde hic calistirilmadi' demek degil, cunku paketin kendi kontrol dosyasi modulun bir kopyasini kendi surecinde zaten calistiriyor; artik ne 'ilk defa burada yukleniyor' ne de 'hic calistirilmadi' diyoruz, sadece 'bu ornek yuklemedi' diyoruz. ucuncu red ise ancak yukleme denemesi BASLADIKTAN sonra olabiliyor, oncesinde asla. Bu redde iki ayri durum var ve ikisi tek cumleye sikistirilmiyor: yukleme sirasinda hata firlarsa modul hic yuklenmemis olabilir; firlamazsa modul yuklenmistir ve arayuz kontrolu o yuklemeden sonra yapilir. 'Her zaman yuklenmis olur' demiyoruz, cunku dogru degil. O ucuncu durumda da program 1 ile cikiyor, ekrana rapor yazmiyor ve tek sabit hata satirini veriyor — ama 'yuklenmeden once reddediyor' demek yanlis olurdu, o yuzden artik demiyoruz. O ucuncu durumu calistiran bir test de yok; davranis kodun kendisinden okunuyor, gecen bir testten degil. Duzeltmeden sonra tam test takimi bilerek tekrar kosulmadi; sadece bu paketin kendi testi ve 10 kontrolcu kosuldu, geri kalanini CI kapatacak. Ayrica uc yeni kucuk bulgu kayda gecti, hicbiri engelleyici degil: donmus testin baslik ve basligi disinda dosya basindaki aciklamasi da ayni genis ifadeyi tasiyor; protokolun 'dort girdi' listesi tek basina calistirilabilir bir paket klasoru uretmeye yetmiyor; ve testin altinci reddedis vakasi adinda gecen kapiyi tek basina kanitlamiyor.
ownerFacing.kullaniciYolculugu: Bir CRM'in 'kayit olustur' aksiyonunu paketleyip disaridaki bir ekibe verdigimizi dusunun. Once o ekip paketi aliyordu ve elinde ne bir kural ne de calisan bir ornek vardi; bir sey tutmayinca bize soruyordu, biz de yardim ediyorduk ve o yardim hicbir yere yazilmiyordu. Simdi ekip tam dort dosya aliyor, ornegi tek komutla calistiriyor: paket saglamsa ekranda tek bir ornek rapor beliriyor (ornek istek, kabul edilen sonuc, hata zarfi), bozuksa hicbir rapor cikmiyor ve tek satirlik sabit bir kod cikiyor. Bize sordugu her soru da artik zaman, kanal, soru ve cevap olarak kayda gecmek zorunda; gizlenirse deneme gecersiz sayiliyor. Yine de bu calistirilabilir bir urun degil: sunucu yok, veritabani yok, gercek kullanici akisi yok, ve henuz hicbir ekip bunu denemedi.
ownerFacing.kalanEngel: Paketi yazmayan taze bir reviewer onayi bekliyor; kosullu bandin yedi kosulundan altisi yesil, yedincisi beklemede, bu yuzden paket henuz teslim edilebilir degil. CI QA2 bekliyor, commit atilmadi. Asil P24 hala eksik: disaridan bagimsiz uc ekip yok, ekip sayisi 0, sahip yardimi olculmedi. Yol haritasi sayaci 23/25 tamamlandi, P24 aktif.
